posts.text: If your wallet is small and it’s still not growing, read this. You don’t need bigger trades. You need better risk management. Let’s say you have a $200 wallet. Before entering any trade, decide one thing first: “How much am I okay losing if this trade is wrong?” For example, fix your maximum risk at $5 per trade. Now don’t randomly put $5 as margin and choose 20x leverage. That’s not how it works. First find your entry, then find the technical stop-loss the level where your trade idea becomes invalid. Suppose your SL is 5% away. Maximum risk = $5 SL distance = 5% Position size = $5 ÷ 5% = $100 Only after this calculate the leverage according to the margin you want to use. If you use $10 margin: $100 ÷ $10 = 10x leverage So if the 5% SL gets hit, your planned loss is around $5, not your whole account. posts.text: South Korea is likely to delay its planned crypto gains tax for a fourth time, potentially to 2029. The presidential office is discussing a postponement, according to The Block, citing Newsis. The tax is scheduled for Jan. 1, 2027; it would levy 22% on annual gains above a 2.5 million won deduction. Newsis cited the U.S. joining the OECD’s Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework in 2029, two years after South Korea, and the resulting lack of U.S. trading data for tracking overseas transactions. A ruling party bill also proposes a Jan. 1, 2029 start. The government is expected to decide after consultations, with tax law discussions expected between late November and early December.

According to ChainCatcher, the metric tracks the average acquisition price of BTC last transferred over the past one to three months, and has climbed to the mid-$70,000 range while BTC trades in the low-$80,000 range. According to ChainCatcher, he said the world would recognize within the next two years that crypto is better prepared for these threats than the internet and traditional finance. He said the crypto market has been a trillion-dollar, irreversible honeypot for a decade, making it an attractive target for attackers. This has created a system tested in real-world conditions more than almost anywhere else, along with an adversarial security culture.

Developers can customize opcodes, gas rules, transaction types and precompiled contracts without changing the core code. All three are currently built on revm.

Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said the two countries would turn potential into tangible results, building on progress over the past year. Last year, the UAE pledged to invest C$70 billion (about $50 billion) in Canada, with key areas including energy, artificial intelligence, logistics and mining.

Al Rajhi Bank fell to its lowest level since 2024 and led declines by points; Maaden, ACWA Power and Saudi Aramco were also among the biggest point-weighted decliners. Flynas, which has resumed flights to Riyadh, rose. Over the weekend, Yemen’s Houthi forces continued attacks on Saudi Arabia, triggering repeated air-raid alerts in Riyadh, Jeddah, Mecca and other locations.

He said venture capital and public markets will become more integrated over the next five years, while capital flowing to a small number of high-quality companies could raise private-market valuations. He advised young investors to consider areas that Wall Street has not fully entered, including private markets, prediction markets, computing power markets and data brokerage. Pompliano also said AI agents could reshape the financial industry and predicted that Tesla and SpaceX would merge to form the largest company in human history.

posts.text: According to Jin10, Sudan's Mineral Resources Company said a collapse at a gold mine in Gedaref State in eastern Sudan on October 25 killed two miners and injured three others. The collapse occurred at an abandoned, closed mine shaft. Although authorities had ordered operations to stop, some miners entered the shaft to mine. The company is investigating the cause and circumstances of the accident. Sudan is rich in mineral resources, and its gold production and exports rank among the highest in Africa and are a major source of foreign exchange. Gold production relies on traditional mining methods, while safety facilities and working conditions are limited in some mining areas, where mine collapses and other accidents occur from time to time.

posts.text: Apple’s iPhone Duo failed JerryRigEverything’s latest durability test. According to Sina Finance, despite its IP68 dust-resistance rating, dust entered the hinge through several gaps and caused the magnetic closure mechanism to fail. After a subsequent bend test, the inner display developed a permanent green line and stopped responding to touch. The outer display, equipped with a second-generation Ceramic Shield panel, showed scratches only at Mohs hardness level 7, while the inner display withstood abrasion only up to level 2. The inner display’s matte nano-texture coating performed reasonably well, with fine scratches seemingly disappearing. Even so, the device did not pass the test. Nelson said he had been conducting these tests since the first foldable phone appeared seven years ago, and that most devices had held up, but the iPhone Duo did not.

posts.text: Electrum disclosed a high-risk vulnerability exploited by malicious servers to redirect bitcoin payments when users raised transaction fees, affecting versions released before 4.8.3. According to Odaily, Electrum received reports of two related incidents, including one in which a user lost funds. The attack could intercept a broadcast transaction and replace it in the wallet’s history with a fake transaction sending funds to an attacker-controlled address. When a user increased the fee through Replace-by-Fee (RBF), Electrum could sign the malicious transaction. Attackers also generated addresses with the same final four characters as the intended recipient’s address. Electrum said the vulnerability was fixed in version 4.8.3 and advised users to update and check recipient addresses and amounts before signing transactions.
